Birch (revision 1): Independently administered; replies within two working days. Support is available 09:00–17:00 Monday to Saturday. Urgent requests use chat, except when maintenance closes chat. Chat charges are unspecified.

Alder (revision 2): Independently administered; replies within three working days. Support is available 08:00–16:00 Monday to Friday. Urgent requests use telephone, except on public holidays. Telephone charges are unspecified.

Comparison: Birch's stated reply window is one working day shorter; this does not establish that every Birch reply arrives sooner. Both list eight-hour daily support windows, but Alder starts and ends one hour earlier, while Birch also lists Saturday support. The urgent channels and exceptions differ: maintenance-related chat closure for Birch versus a public-holiday exception for Alder's telephone channel. Neither source identifies an alternative urgent channel during its exception. These exceptions do not establish that all support is unavailable. Unspecified charges must not be treated as free, and the independently administered services' conditions must not be transferred between them.
